Name: Envia's Floors And Fence
Author: ANYUEnvia
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]画了一些看上去有层次的地板，顺便做了围栏，门和装饰。[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]I've drawn some layered‑looking flooring, along with matching fences, gates and decorations. [/color]

地板因为有动态衔接有时会出现小块灰色，有问题的地方用油漆桶刷一下另一个贴图可以解决。
栅栏为了适配我的地板贴图的位置和原版本相差有点大所以有两个贴图来互相补充。
因为是照着我的地图着色做的，也不清楚在其他地图上的效果呢，应该调调对比度饱和度可以解决吧
The flooring may occasionally show small grey patches due to dynamic tile transitions. You can fix affected tiles by painting them with a different texture using the paint bucket tool.
The fences have significant positional offsets compared to vanilla assets to fit my custom flooring textures, so two texture variants are included to complement each other.
These textures are color‑matched for my own map. I am not sure how they will look on other maps. Adjusting contrast and saturation should help.
